## Step 2: What Belongs in Root AGENTS.md

Only things that genuinely affect **every single task**:

| Keep in root | Why |
|---|---|
| One-sentence project description | Context for everything |
| Package manager (`pnpm`, never `npm`/`npx`) | Affects every install/run command |
| Commands table (`pnpm dev`, `pnpm build`, etc.) | Used constantly |
| Tech stack table | Quick reference, no deep detail |
| Project structure (abbreviated) | Orientation for every task |
| Naming conventions (4 lines) | Affects every file/function created |
| Links to sub-files | Navigation |

Everything else is topic-specific.
